newsitem.title: USA: Phoenix Duff buys GMG/Seneca in $54mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Phoenix Duff buys GMG/Seneca in $54mln deal.

text.p: Phoenix Duff & Phelps Inc said Thursday it will take a majority interest in privately-held GMG/Seneca Capital Management LLC of San Francisco.
The deal values GMG, which manages about $4 billion, at $54 milion, Phoenix Duff said, adding GMG's senior management will keep a significant equity stake and operational control.
The company said on June 9 it agreed to buy privately-held Pasadena Capital Corp, the holding company for Roger Engemann & Associates. The deal valued Pasadena at $180 million, Phoenix Duff said.
Phoenix Duff closed at 7-3/8 today, up 1/8.
